top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single part for the physiology of GLP-1 and the identification of its active form to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The chain from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic GLP-1(7-36) peptide through human incretin physiology and receptor biology to long-acting agonists is complete, mature and tested in randomized outcome trials. The citation is confined to the physiology and the active peptide, not a drug class. The residual weakness is attribution (Mojsov versus Habener, and Knudsen excluded by the three-name cap), but it does not outweigh the science, and no award would forgo a clearly prize-worthy discovery.
